entries.final_answer: Advancing next must agree with query mode: dispatch the actionable WP (e.g. implement WP01 for a rejected WP that fell to planned, or a coord WP the primary dir cannot see); return kind=blocked with a named recovery command ONLY when the board has no actionable WP. Never emit the WP-less composition placeholder as a live advancing loop state.
options: Re-dispatch actionable WP; blocked+recovery only when none actionable
